how_read: curl of raw CHANGELOG.md from traceloop/openllmetry main; whole file shortlisted by keyword grep, about 25 entries read by line range
comment: Only the open-source library entries were used. Evaluator, evaluators route and made-by-Traceloop evaluator lines (platform) were skipped on purpose. Entries without a metric name (crewai histogram #2576, langchain/groq/google-generativeai/milvus/pinecone metrics support, openai-agents initial metrics) were not proposed because the page does not state the metric; the already-recorded names come from the source Meters class. No recorded metric was renamed, deprecated or removed according to the changelog (the entries on metric naming, #1121 and #1182, are from 2024 and predate the recorded names).
